explication: TubaWinUI3 is a Windows desktop toolbox for hardware inspection, benchmarking, system maintenance, networking, conversion, and gaming utilities. The main workflow is to browse or search the shared tool catalog, open a tool, and view results or perform an operation. Distinct branches cover AI-assisted computer operations, hardware and game monitoring, system/security maintenance, and conversion/network utilities. The graph uses README-described capabilities and paths in the supplied tree; sampled source excerpts are incomplete, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
